# Convex AI Files

<!-- This folder is generated by Convex tooling, so these files are reference/state files rather than app code. -->

This folder is part of Convex's generated AI support data.

- `guidelines.md` is the human-readable Convex guidance file. It explains the file-based function layout, validators, query rules, auth rules, and other project conventions that the Convex AI tooling expects.
- `ai-files.state.json` is the generated sync/state file. It stores hashes and metadata so Convex can tell whether the guidance files and installed AI-related config are in sync.

<!-- In other words: the markdown file explains the rules, and the JSON file remembers whether those rules have changed. -->

Use this folder as generated support material, not as normal application logic.
